Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:99148: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Important)

Platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support

Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: ppp: require CAP_NET_ADMIN in target netns for unattached ioctls (CVE-2026-53075)

* kernel: Revert "wireguard: device: enable threaded NAPI" (CVE-2026-52945)

* kernel: Linux kernel: PPP over L2TP Use-After-Free vulnerability (CVE-2026-68398)

* kernel: net: smc: fix splice entry lifetime imbalance in smc_rx_splice (CVE-2026-74631)

* kernel: net: bridge: mcast: fix use-after-free of a master VLAN's multicast context (CVE-2026-80842)

* kernel: RDMA/rxe: Fix responder UAF on IB_QP_MAX_DEST_RD_ATOMIC modify_qp (CVE-2026-80864)

* kernel: RDMA/rxe: Fix OOB in free_rd_atomic_resources() (CVE-2026-80863)

* kernel: i3c: master: svc: bound IBI payload to the requested max_payload_len (CVE-2026-80951)

* kernel: s390/vfio-ap: Fix missing lock required to access list of ap_matrix_mdev objects (CVE-2026-89956)

* kernel: ALSA: seq: midi: Serialize input teardown with event_input (CVE-2026-90207)

* kernel: ALSA: pcm: Serialize PCM mmap with buffer reallocation to fix page UAF (CVE-2026-98116)

* kernel: smb: client: validate absolute native symlink targets before NT fixups (CVE-2026-98318)

* kernel: kernel: Denial of Service via unvalidated task in iSCSI management responses (CVE-2026-99152)

* kernel: kernel: Denial of service via unvalidated task tag in iSCSI Reject PDU (CVE-2026-99153)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Backport request: bonding: only set speed/duplex to unknown, if getting speed failed [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:RHEL-178992)

* [AMDSERVER 9.8 Feature] Venice: EDAC Updates [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:RHEL-216566)

* Kernel panic after stopping retis capture  [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:RHEL-275459)

* Hard lockup experienced with repro from RHEL-282072 [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:RHEL-290030)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
